news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 4 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 4 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. Independent Director Khushbu Nadapara is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2025. The company’s lack of experienced directors is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.0% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. news.body: After last week's 21% share price decline to ₹20.13, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 4x. Average trailing P/E is 22x in the Chemicals industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 16% over the past three years.

news.title: Pratiksha Chemicals Limited Approves the Appointment of Sumit Harjibhai as Managing Director
news.body: Pratiksha Chemicals Limited at its Extra Ordinary General Meeting held on February 20, 2026, approved the appointment of Mr. Sumit Harjibhai Gol (DIN: 11367027) as Managing Director of the Company.

news.title: Pratiksha Chemicals Limited Announces Director Appointments
news.body: Pratiksha Chemicals Limited at its Extra Ordinary General Meeting held on February 20, 2026, approved regularisation of Appointment of Mr. Kishan Rajeshbhai Mendapara (DIN: 11450994), as an Independent Director of the Company; approved regularisation of Appointment of Ms. Khushbu Hemanshu Nadapara (DIN:11386775), as an Independent Director of the Company; approved regularization of Mr. Kalpesh Kamani as Director (DIN: 11366816) of the Company.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.17 (vs ₹9.92 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.17 (up from ₹9.92 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹2.27m (down 87% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹927.0k (up ₹56.2m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 41% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 68 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: Pratiksha Chemicals Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 282.011611 million in funding
news.body: Pratiksha Chemicals Limited announced a private placement of 8,717,750 Equity Shares at a price per share of INR 21.72 for gross proceeds of INR 189,349,530 and 17,064,840 Pre-Funded Fully Convertible Warrants at an issue price per warrant of INR 5.43 for gross proceeds of INR 92,662,081.2, and aggregate gross proceeds of INR 282,011,611.2 on preferential basis on January 21, 2026. The transaction involves participation from returning investors NEELSAGAR CONSULTANCY SERVICE LLP for 897,790 warrants,  RUDRAAVTAR CONSULTANCY SERVICES LLP for 874,770 warrants,  VINTAGE DIAMOND LLP for 920,810 warrants, MARKAND TRADEVENTURE LLP for 897,790 warrants, LANKINI MANAGEMENT CONSULTANCY LLP for 897,790 warrants, SUNRISE TRADELINK LLP for 897,790 warrants and news investors EKNATHESHWAR MULTITRADE LLP
